actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sahuagin makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aquatic Charge
bonus_actions.desc: The sahuagin swims up to its Swim Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

special_abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
special_abilities.desc: The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its Hit Points.

special_abilities.name: Limited Amphibiousness
special_abilities.desc: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

special_abilities.name: Shark Telepathy
special_abilities.desc: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.
